## [1.27.0](https://github.com/jagjordi/morphe-patches/compare/v1.26.0...v1.27.0) (2026-10-26)

### ✨ New Features

* **caltopo:** add Unlock Desktop features patch ([9f8b8e4](https://github.com/jagjordi/morphe-patches/commit/9f8b8e4454ffc9d1b2e932867b6724cd54863c2a))

patches.name: Unlock Desktop features
patches.description: Resolves the CalTopo account to the Desktop feature tier on the device, which enables the client gated features: offline layer downloads for every tier, the 3D view, travel plan statistics, custom icons, parcel measurement and elevation in exports. Works with or without a signed in account. Restricted layer tiles and packaged offline downloads are still produced by the CalTopo server, which applies its own account check.

options.description: CalTopo feature group id to resolve the account to. Desktop is the highest personal tier.

patches.name: Open data for premium fields
patches.description: Fills the aircraft panel fields that the Flightradar24 server withholds from non-subscribers using open data: extended Mode S values (IAS, TAS, Mach, outside air temperature, GPS altitude and wind) from the adsb.lol and adsb.fi public APIs, serial number and aircraft age from the OpenSky Network aircraft database, and the flight information region from VATSpy boundaries. The aircraft and FIR data are downloaded once a month from a GitHub release. Values the server does send are never replaced.

options.description: Base URL that serves aircraft.db.gz and firs.json.gz. Defaults to the weekly build published as the open-data prerelease of jagjordi/morphe-patches.
Base URL of a readsb style v2 API, queried as <url><hex>. Defaults to api.adsb.lol; opendata.adsb.fi is tried as a fallback.

patches.name: Open weather radar
patches.description: Draws the precipitation radar layers (global, North American and Australian) from RainViewer's public radar tiles when Flightradar24 does not issue weather credentials to the account. Layers that have no open source (satellite cloud, forecast wind, icing, turbulence and lightning) are left as they are.

options.description: RainViewer weather maps index that lists the current radar frames.

patches.name: Unlock Business Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Business-tier features in Flightradar24: ad-free experience, weather layers, ATC routes, 3D view, flight history playback, unlimited saved locations and the country of registration. Works with or without a Flightradar24 account. Serial number and aircraft age stay locked because the server never sends them to non-subscribers.

options.description: Optional. A Google Maps Android API key to inject into the app manifest if the map stays blank after patching. Leave empty to keep the original key.
